source_title: Second-Order Thinking: What Smart People Use to Outperform
creator: Shane Parrish
why_this_fits: Introduces second-order thinking, the 'and then what?' model, and evaluating cascading downstream consequences of decisions.

source_title: Introduction to System Dynamics Modeling
creator: System Dynamics Society
why_this_fits: Hands-on introductory tutorial guiding learners through sketching their first system with purpose, elements, stocks, flows, and delays.

source_title: The Systemcraft Frame: Understanding System Structure and Stocks
creator: Queensland University of Technology
why_this_fits: Provides a comprehensive architectural foundation for stocks, accumulations, and systemic structures.

source_title: Craft Skills as Thinking Skills: Graphing Dynamics and Patterns
creator: Queensland University of Technology
why_this_fits: Teaches how to shift from snapshot events to dynamic patterns over time, tracing trajectories and feedback signals.

source_title: Mental Models: The Best Way to Make Intelligent Decisions
creator: Shane Parrish
why_this_fits: Examines how internal mental models simplify and distort reality, and how to construct multi-disciplinary lattices of mental models.

source_title: And Then What? Moving from Linear to Systemic Causality
creator: Queensland University of Technology
why_this_fits: Contrasts direct linear cause-and-effect with closed feedback loops and circular systemic causality.

source_title: How to Frame the Focussing Question for System Diagrams
creator: Queensland University of Technology

source_title: Implications for Leaders and Managers: Diagnosing Root Causes
creator: Queensland University of Technology

source_title: The Limits to Growth

creator: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy

source_title: Systems Leadership for Global Sustainability: Avoiding Systemic Collapse
creator: Queensland University of Technology

source_title: No, Really, Why So? Diagnosing Compensating Feedback and Policy Resistance
creator: Queensland University of Technology
why_this_fits: Examines why systems fight back against external interventions through compensating balancing loops and behavioral adaptation.

source_title: System Dynamics Self-Study: Dynamic Hypothesis Formulation
creator: MIT OpenCourseWare
why_this_fits: Structured MIT OCW curriculum guiding the formulation of dynamic hypotheses and mapping dominant loop shifts over time.

source_title: Applied System Dynamics Case: Managing Delay-Driven Dynamics
creator: Queensland University of Technology
why_this_fits: Real-world case study diagnosing recurring boom-bust oscillation and growth plateaus caused by delayed feedback.

source_title: Philosophy of Science and System Models
creator: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy

source_title: System Dynamics Modeling and Simulation Principles
creator: MIT OpenCourseWare
why_this_fits: Authoritative MIT lecture series detailing structural verification, extreme conditions testing, calibration, and behavior reproduction.

source_title: Where Are We in This? Boundary Judgments and Stakeholder Perspective
creator: Queensland University of Technology

source_title: Scientific Sensitivity Analysis and Uncertainty Quantification
creator: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy
why_this_fits: Addresses parameter sensitivity, structural robustness, Monte Carlo testing, and validating model behavior under uncertainty.

source_title: Building Dynamic Models: From Question to Formal System Specification
creator: Queensland University of Technology
why_this_fits: Guides learners through building a formal stock-and-flow model with explicit equations, running simulations, and checking boundary constraints.

source_title: Distinguishing Systems Leadership and Applied Modeling in the Literature
creator: Queensland University of Technology

creator: Queensland University of Technology

source_title: What's Possible: Navigating System Complexity and Overcoming Policy Resistance
creator: Queensland University of Technology
why_this_fits: Provides strategic frameworks for anticipating and overcoming deep structural policy resistance in organizational interventions.

source_title: Introduction to Systems Intervention: Mapping Intervention Matrices
creator: Queensland University of Technology
why_this_fits: Hands-on tutorial for mapping symptom, structure, feedback loops, incentives, and intervention points in an intervention matrix.

source_title: Introduction to Systems Leadership: Implementing Tested Interventions
creator: Queensland University of Technology
why_this_fits: Real-world application guide for designing bounded intervention tests, tracking leading indicators, and measuring system adaptation.

source_title: Core Paradigm: Constructing Multi-Level Intervention Models
creator: Queensland University of Technology

source_title: Systems Thinking and Strategic Action in Dynamic Environments
creator: Queensland University of Technology
why_this_fits: Demonstrates practical design and execution of systemic change programs, setting guardrails, and tracking unintended feedback.

creator: Queensland University of Technology
why_this_fits: Explores relational feedback, interpersonal dynamics, cultural paradigms, and family/group systems structures.

source_title: Market Systems and Economic Complexity
creator: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy

source_title: Philosophy of Technology: Sociotechnical Systems and Complexity
creator: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy
why_this_fits: Examines large-scale sociotechnical networks, platform lock-in, modularity, technical debt, and infrastructural feedback.

source_title: Systemic Public Policy Analysis and Multi-Actor Environments
creator: Open Textbook Library (TU Delft / University of Minnesota)
why_this_fits: Textbook on applying systems analysis to complex public policy, urban governance, multi-stakeholder conflicts, and institutional feedback.

source_title: Practical Methods for Systemic Domain Modeling
creator: Queensland University of Technology
why_this_fits: Tutorial on producing an integrated domain model with stakeholders, flows, delays, incentives, and implementation blueprints.

source_title: Applying Systems Thinking to Macro Organizational Practice
creator: Open Textbook Library (University of Minnesota)
why_this_fits: Hands-on real-world application study improving project decision-making, tracking baseline interventions, and managing side-effects.

source_title: The Atlas for the Aspiring Network Scientist
creator: Michele Coscia (arXiv / Harvard)

source_title: Introduction to Agent-Based Modeling
creator: Santa Fe Institute (Complexity Explorer)

source_title: Systemic Risk in Banking Ecosystems and Complex Networks

why_this_fits: Classic work on systemic contagion, network resilience, tipping points, and cascading collapse in tightly coupled financial networks.

source_title: Leading in Health and Social Care: Systems Thinking in Organizational Learning
creator: Open Textbook Library (University of Minnesota)

source_title: The Practice of Critical Systems Thinking and Intervention Ethics
creator: Open Educational Alberta

source_title: Multilayer Network Science: Theory, Methods, and Modeling Practice
creator: Massimo Stella et al. (arXiv)
why_this_fits: Guides learners through constructing and comparing advanced multi-layer and agent networks, analyzing model assumptions and boundaries.

source_title: Sustaining the Commons: Applied Institutional Analysis and Dynamic Governance
creator: Open Textbook Library (Arizona State / University of Minnesota)
